title: Contact Us
description: Contact PBZero Wiki. Report content errors, send feedback, or request new guides for Phantom Blade Zero.

sections.title: Get in Touch
sections.content:
We welcome corrections, feedback, and guide requests. Email us at:

contact@pbzero.wiki

sections.title: What to Send Us
sections.content:
• Content corrections — spotted an error in a boss guide, weapon list, or character page? Tell us the page and what is wrong.
  • Guide requests — is there a topic we have not covered yet? Let us know.
  • Feedback — anything that would make the Site more useful.
  • Takedown requests — if you are a rights holder and have a concern about content on this Site, contact us directly and we will respond promptly.

sections.title: Response Time
sections.content: This Site is run by a small team. We read every message and aim to reply within a few business days. Corrections are prioritized.
